responsibility: Owns rustc metadata I/O for the Cranelift backend. It implements rustc’s `MetadataLoader` so crate metadata can be read back from rlibs and dylibs, and it provides the writer-side logic that chooses whether metadata should be omitted, stored raw in rlibs, or compressed into a `.rustc` object section for dylibs and proc-macro outputs via the backend object-writing abstraction.
